description: Compute the exact span between two dates: total days, weeks and days, a calendar breakdown in years, months and days, and the number of business days (Monday to Friday; public holidays are not known). Leap years and month lengths are handled. Use it for ages, deadlines, contract terms and "how long until" — date subtraction is a classic place for a model to be off by one.

end.description: End date, in the same form. May be earlier than start.

include_end_date.description: Count the end date as a full day too (a deadline "from the 1st to the 5th inclusive" is 5 days, not 4).

start.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD. A time may follow (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm).

name: date_diff
title: Difference between two dates
